summary: Three climbers stranded on the Third Flatiron by stuck rope in rain and darkness; RMRG assisted all; uninjured.
notes: Merged 2026-09-10: RMRG 2013 annual page confirms incident; adds detail that the climbers delayed calling for help until dusk fearing rescue charges, and were rescued as rain and snow began to fall. RMRG notes it does not charge for rescue. [Merged 2026-09-11: RMRG analysis page: 3 college students rappelling East Face at sunset on an unseasonably warm day, rope stuck 200 ft above base; ~90 min of self-rescue attempts before calling 911; volunteers climbed above the party and lowered them on rain-soaked rock.]
